tools.name: run_sciatica_information_check

tools.name: assess_next_step
tools.description: Return a NON-DIAGNOSTIC next-step suggestion for lower back / sciatica / disc symptoms. Set redFlags=true if the person reports loss of bladder/bowel control, saddle numbness, foot drop, or rapidly worsening weakness.

tools.name: get_education_article
tools.description: Get the full plain-text content of a single Education Center article by slug.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "run_sciatica_information_check" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
